title: Athens: the beginnings of democracy
subtitle: Cleisthenes’ reforms · c. 508–507 BCE · Athens and Attica

facts.label: 10 civic tribes [1, 2]
facts.detail: Cleisthenes reorganized the citizen body into ten tribes, mixing city, coastal and inland communities.

facts.label: 500 council members [1]
facts.detail: The Council expanded to 500 members: 50 from each tribe. These are institutional places, not party seats won.

facts.label: Participation had limits [3]
facts.detail: Adult male citizens took part. Women, resident foreigners and enslaved people were excluded from political participation.

explainer.legend: Map key: dot = approximate Athens city location [4]; neutral land = modern geographic reference.
explainer.caveat: Historical overview, not election results. No vote, turnout or party-seat totals are asserted. Institutions developed over time; the date is a conventional reform period, not a polling date.
